teaser: A door closes behind you before anyone else finishes deciding whether to open it. A plan changes shape mid-sentence because you changed it. Life path 1, called The Leader, crossed with an ENTJ temperament reads less like a title and more like a default setting. The number's pull toward self-command and the type's instinct to organize whatever sits in front of it aim at the same outcome: someone who moves first and explains after. What's particular here is how little friction exists between wanting to lead and being built to. The question this raises isn't whether you can run things, but what happens on days nobody asked you to.
excerpt: The car keys wait by the door, moved there an hour before anyone agreed it was time to leave.
